ops.text: drive job report refused a reader report as lacking rulings:, exists:, open: and build: even though all four lines were present, because the header read 'Researched: j5556' and brief.RESEARCHED (plugins/long-running/lib/drive/brief.py:25) matches only a bare 'Researched:' line. The refusal text comes from brief.BLOCK (brief.py:138), 'a Researched: line and under it rulings:, exists: and open: lines', which never says the line must be bare, so it pointed at the wrong fix. Fix: make BLOCK say 'a bare Researched: line' and update its expectations in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_hooks.py, or have RESEARCHED accept trailing text.
